bio: This former toll station on the Turnhout-Antwerp road has morphed into a sophisticated restaurant. The sleek annexe drips with designer luxury and gilt details, and the open kitchen is sure to draw the eye as soon as you arrive. The chef works with top-notch ingredients, elevating them regularly with subtle Asian touches and the bold flavours of Italy. Whether in the form of langoustine with wawasai and enoki, or tagliatelle with truffle and horn of plenty, this modern approach to the principle of less is more is captivating....
